title: Household risk
sentence: Delta and Vega come from the latest capture; Beta-weighted Delta, the volatility range and the standard metrics are not built: no job stores Beta, the index price or risk metrics.

delta.title: Delta by underlying
delta.meaning: How many dollars the result of the positions changes when each underlying moves one dollar; stocks count by shares.

vega.meaning: How many dollars the result of the option structures changes when volatility moves one point.

beta_delta.title: Beta-weighted Delta
beta_delta.meaning: Delta of each underlying converted to the benchmark index by Beta.

gap.text: Beta-weighted Delta is not built: no job stores the Beta of each underlying or the benchmark index price

sigma.title: Volatility range
sigma.meaning: Result range at one and two standard deviations.

gap.text: The volatility range is not built: how it is defined from the stored IV is not designed yet

metrics.label: Standard risk metrics
metrics.explanation: The standard risk metrics are not built: no job stores a risk metrics source
